real.evidence: The contract in full — five principles, named-gate and mutation-test contracts, certification. Version 0.1 (draft), Apache-2.0.
Required checks matched by name; a skipped or neutral result is a fail, never a silent pass. spec.md §3 + example/demo.mjs.
A guard is proven only by a recorded run where a seeded fault made it go red. spec.md §4; demo.mjs seeds a 'ghost' import and asserts red.
Dependency-free example/demo.mjs showing both contracts; `node example/demo.mjs` exits 0 when the discipline holds.
Structural gate, prove-the-check-can-fail, separate reviewer, failures-become-memory, provenance. README + spec.md §2.

Specified (§5 conformance audit + badge scope) but no runnable audit tooling ships in this repo.
Specified as a ratchet (new unproven guards refused); no public proven-vs-unproven count is published here.

callout: A gate enforces only that a named check ran and reported a non-neutral pass — it does not make the check correct. Correctness is the mutation test's job: a guard that has never gone red is indistinguishable from one that does nothing, so unproven guards are counted separately and refused until proven.
where: Toward a version-scoped, annual conformance audit that earns the Valiant Verification mark, with the unproven-guard backlog closed to zero and the SDK and corpus published for implementers.
